name: "Cunning" Chris Kincade
caption: Fought Christian Hawk to a double count-out on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast after both men brawled outside the ring.

name: "Wild Thing" Christian Hawk
caption: Battled Chris Kincade to a double count-out and then struck him with a chair after the bell on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

name: "The Perfect Specimen" Brock Carden

tenures.source: Fights in the winning War Games team at Boston Massacre (27 June 1998); headlines the promotion's own final surviving broadcast, winning a Chicago Street Fight over "Confident" Lawrence Williams with champion Ian Walsh's help.
tenures.note: Two-axis match: identical distinctive nickname ("The Perfect Specimen") and an identical date (31 May 1998) already on this record's own existing cow-1998 tenure, consistent with the same overlapping community of handlers running several small federations at once, evidenced directly by "Confident" Lawrence Williams's own cross-promotional promo text naming both CoW and IeWC together.

caption: Defeated Jeet Kune Do with a fisherman suplex on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

name: Jeet Kune Do
caption: Lost to Brock Carden by fisherman suplex after knocking out the referee mid-match on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

name: "The Revolution" Jack Stone
caption: Rallied from a beating to powerbomb The Ruiner for the win, at 10:21, on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

name: The Ruiner
caption: Dominated most of his match against Jack Stone before being caught with a late powerbomb, at 10:21, on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

identity.note: A different persona of the same generic ring name is recorded elsewhere; nothing links the two beyond the bare name.

name: "The Hardline" Chris Pain
caption: Tapped out to "Confident" Lawrence Williams' Clutch of Confidence on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

name: Eric Wayne
caption: Pinned The Pink Passion at 17:42 on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast.

identity.note: An existing RSPWF Top 200 poll stub carries this bare name with a different nickname and different tagged federations; nothing in this pass's own reading links the two beyond the bare name.

name: The Pink Passion
caption: Lost to Eric Wayne by pinfall at 17:42 on Classic On-Line Wrestling's debut broadcast, managed to ringside by two valets.

name: Lord Gunthar the Protector
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (20 June 1998), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/grade-this-roleplay-for-me-1998-06-20.html: Lord Gunthar the Protector, in a gray hooded sweatshirt, says a motorcycle accident ended his rise in the IWF/WOW and announces his return in the CoW.
caption: A returning wrestler formerly of the IWF/WOW who joins the CoW after a motorcycle accident, June 1998.
